name: [Open Beta Test] Digimon: Reboot World
desc:
A game created for true Digimon lovers. The game is an MMORPG, it contains a lot of farming and several objectives to follow in the game!

📣 Attention!
The game is in Open Beta Test. Errors and Glitches may happen, but we will always be on the lookout to resolve them as soon as possible!

🐲 300+ Digimon to collect and evolve!
💍 80+ Different equipment and accessories!
🏹 Dungeons and Colosseum to participate in!
👹 Bosses to defeat in zones across the digital world!
🕹️ Role-play with friends and help each other out!
🛡️ Protect the Digital World from devastation and evil beings!

Shortcuts:

B - Bag 🎒
V - Digimon Information 👾
Z - Titles 🏆
G - Digimon Index 📖
Y - Cash Shop 💰
